name: P-015 R-3 live-plane observation (2026-09-27b): a Claude su carry-respawn reaches applied in its FIRST turn, so its first tool call and first Anthropic inference sample join the relaunched specification (WI-10003459 fix live on :3170)
command: sudo -n -u postgres psql -d papercusp -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -F' | ' -A < .papercusp/scratch/r3-live-0927/q2.sql   # read-only; SQL + output in replication[]
timeBasis: All E-section timestamps are rendered AT TIME ZONE UTC. Tool-row and inference readings are bounded to [14:54:00Z, 15:00:00Z) so a re-run returns the same counts; the 15:00Z interactive-usage ingest (cron 0 */10 * * * *) had already landed every sample in that window.
summary: The subject is this observer's own Claude su session su-fcbb3fed (adv_sessions 31144). Before the respawn the baseline max activation event id was 23754 (applied 99f849c86034). The carry-respawn wrote desired 23756 (source restart, spec b3e6df443c23) at 14:56:00.962Z from the predecessor native session 19ae63bd, then the SUCCESSOR native session e3c4b9ff wrote applied 23757 at 14:56:02.663Z, 1.70 s later, with no prepared phase and no failure. That is before the successor's first inference sample (14:56:10.755Z) and first tool call (14:56:11.327Z). All 62 successor tool rows and all 27 successor Anthropic samples in the window join 23757/b3e6df443c23; the predecessor's 21 tool rows and 12 samples all end before 14:56:02.663Z and join 23754/99f849c86034. The launch receipt adv_sessions 31144 carries session_id e3c4b9ff and specificationRevision b3e6df443c23. The writing host :3170 served build ecb97b7ae5, which contains the fix (applyRelaunchedActivation in control-anchor.ts called from turn-start-memory.ts). The before-fix reading shows the defect this replaces: after the 13:58Z respawn the pre-fix build left applied on the old revision until the next turn, so tool and Anthropic inference rows to 14:11:40Z joined activation 23646 while the process ran b4a393278a74.

assertions.evidence: E1: desired 23756 (restart, b3e6df443c23, native 19ae63bd, 14:56:00.962Z) is followed by applied 23757 (control, b3e6df443c23, native e3c4b9ff, 14:56:02.663Z). The applier is the successor session, 1.70 s after desired, with no prepared phase and no failure.
Applied 14:56:02.663Z precedes the successor's first inference sample 714503 (14:56:10.755Z, E4/E5) and its first tool row (14:56:11.327Z, E3).

E7: adv_sessions 31144 session_id e3c4b9ff, launch specificationRevision b3e6df443c23 and stateRevision 18cf633bd759 equal applied 23757 (E1) and the revision stamped on every successor tool and inference row (E3/E4).
E2: span 23754 (99f849c86034) ends at exactly 14:56:02.662619Z, where span 23757 (b3e6df443c23) begins; 23757 is open.
E3: 62 successor tool rows (14:56:11.327Z-14:59:58.072Z, 61 ok) join 23757/b3e6df443c23; the 21 predecessor rows end at 14:56:02.495Z, before applied, and join 23754/99f849c86034.

E4/E5: all 27 successor Anthropic opus interactive samples 714503-714529 (14,267 output tokens) join 23757/b3e6df443c23; the predecessor's 12 samples 714491-714502 end at 14:55:58.740Z and join 23754. Per-session raw counts (E5) equal the attributed counts (E4), so no sample is unattributed or misattributed.

E6: every su-fcbb3fed tool row from 14:55:08Z on was served by :3170 build ecb97b7ae5; that build contains applyRelaunchedActivation in control-anchor.ts and its call in turn-start-memory.ts (checked by this builder).
E1/E2: actor_id = owner_id and principal system:superuser on every event and span across the relaunch.

notProven: A Codex or OMP relaunch through the same path: this reading is a Claude su carry-respawn. The fix is client-agnostic (turn-start route), and earlier Codex attribution is carried by the 2026-09-27 observation.
The pending-specification fail-closed denial: carried by docs/evidence/p015-r3-live-observation-2026-09-27.json; this respawn applied before any denial could occur.
Final release deployment: :3170 staging build, not :3070.

replication.sql:
\pset footer off
set statement_timeout='100s';
-- R-3 live proof for the WI-10003459 fix: the 14:56Z carry-respawn of su-fcbb3fed.
-- Window is FIXED to [2026-09-27 14:54:00Z, 15:00:00Z) so the readings are reproducible.
\echo === observed_at
SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at;
\echo === E1 activation events for su-fcbb3fed, id >= 23754 (baseline max id before the respawn = 23754)
SELECT e.id, e.control_generation AS gen, e.phase, e.source, e.stack_refs, left(e.specification_revision,12) AS spec, left(e.state_revision,12) AS state, e.adv_session_id AS adv, e.native_session_id, e.actor_id = e.owner_id AS actor_is_owner, e.principal_id, e.failure, e.recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS recorded_at_utc
  FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_events e
 WHERE e.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND e.owner_id='su-fcbb3fed-83b5-4c34-9dab-72e191d76491' AND e.id >= 23754 AND e.recorded_at < '2026-09-27 15:00:00Z'
 ORDER BY e.id;
\echo === E2 per-layer spans for those activations
SELECT activation_event_id, control_generation, layer_slot, layer_ref, left(specification_revision,12) AS spec, actor_id = owner_id AS actor_is_owner, principal_id, active_from AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS active_from_utc, active_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS active_until_utc
  FROM harness_shared.session_identity_layer_spans
 WHERE owner_id='su-fcbb3fed-83b5-4c34-9dab-72e191d76491' AND activation_event_id IN (23754, 23757)
 ORDER BY activation_event_id, layer_slot;
\echo === E3 tool rows by activation in the window
SELECT identity_activation_event_id AS act, left(identity_specification_revision,12) AS spec, identity_stack_refs, serving_host, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='ok') AS ok, min(invoked_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS first_utc, max(invoked_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS last_utc
  FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations_identity_attribution
 WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND coord_owner_id='su-fcbb3fed-83b5-4c34-9dab-72e191d76491' AND invoked_at >= '2026-09-27 14:54:00Z' AND invoked_at < '2026-09-27 15:00:00Z'
 GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,4;
\echo === E4 inference samples by activation in the window
SELECT identity_activation_event_id AS act, left(identity_specification_revision,12) AS spec, identity_stack_refs, count(*) AS n, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, min(id) AS min_id, max(id) AS max_id, min(to_timestamp(ts/1000.0)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS first_utc, max(to_timestamp(ts/1000.0)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS last_utc, array_agg(DISTINCT model_class) AS model_classes, array_agg(DISTINCT source) AS sources, array_agg(DISTINCT provider) AS providers
  FROM harness_shared.agent_usage_samples_identity_attribution
 WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND identity_owner_id='su-fcbb3fed-83b5-4c34-9dab-72e191d76491'
   AND ts >= (extract(epoch FROM timestamptz '2026-09-27 14:54:00Z')*1000)::bigint
   AND ts <  (extract(epoch FROM timestamptz '2026-09-27 15:00:00Z')*1000)::bigint
 GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1;
\echo === E5 inference samples by native session in the window (raw table, no attribution view)
SELECT session_id, count(*) AS n, min(id) AS min_id, max(id) AS max_id, min(to_timestamp(ts/1000.0)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS first_utc, max(to_timestamp(ts/1000.0)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS last_utc
  FROM harness_shared.agent_usage_samples
 WHERE session_id IN ('19ae63bd-3437-4d2c-abb7-2740e74c9e22','e3c4b9ff-98cd-4013-a6ba-cb20dfc16a3f')
   AND ts >= (extract(epoch FROM timestamptz '2026-09-27 14:54:00Z')*1000)::bigint
   AND ts <  (extract(epoch FROM timestamptz '2026-09-27 15:00:00Z')*1000)::bigint
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3;
\echo === E6 serving builds for su-fcbb3fed tool rows in the window
SELECT serving_host, serving_build_sha, count(*) AS n, min(invoked_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS first_utc, max(invoked_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS last_utc
  FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations
 WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND coord_owner_id='su-fcbb3fed-83b5-4c34-9dab-72e191d76491' AND invoked_at >= '2026-09-27 14:54:00Z' AND invoked_at < '2026-09-27 15:00:00Z'
 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 4;
\echo === E7 launch receipt adv_sessions 31144
SELECT id, coord_owner_id, session_id, launch_spec->>'agent' AS agent, launch_spec->>'principalId' AS principal, left(launch_spec->>'specificationRevision',12) AS launch_spec_rev, left(launch_spec->>'stateRevision',12) AS launch_state_rev
  FROM harness_shared.adv_sessions WHERE id = 31144;
